title: AI Security
summary:
Two weeks ago, I attended the [un]prompted AI security conference in San Francisco. It was an excellent event: three days of very dense talks about all aspects of AI security. (My talk was about integrous AI, and I will post it when it is online.)

AI security can be divided into three broad topics. It’s important for researchers to understand which one they are working on. And it’s important for us as a community to work on them all.

title: Zyphra 发布开源 TTS 模型 ZONOS3-Mini，可在手机浏览器实时运行
summary: Zyphra 发布 ZONOS3-Mini，一个 Apache 2.0 开源的零样本语音克隆 TTS 模型，采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数 8 亿、活跃参数 1 亿，在 Pixel 9 浏览器端 Time To First Audio 低于 570 ms，在 M3 MacBook Air 上低于 150 ms。

title: Claude Mythos 5.2 预测基因治疗载体 AAV 衣壳结构
summary: Claude 官方视频介绍 Claude Mythos 5.2 预测了完整 AAV 衣壳结构，即用于递送基因治疗的蛋白质外壳。模型编写代码在相邻五链分组上运行开源折叠模型，再利用衣壳对称性拼合全部 60 条链；在 AAV2 上预测结果与实验结构误差约为一个原子宽度。

title: Redwood Research 分析 OpenAI Astra 在安全任务上的隐性消极表现
